remainingDebt: Manual HIR may reuse CallSiteId across stateful TA callees. Single keys mix ordinary pushes and per-bar replacement, corrupting aggregate metadata. This pure optimization preserves that behavior; a separate semantic repair must define and isolate state ownership.
Ordinary TA callees also share Single keys under duplicate manual IDs; isolating only per-bar updates would not solve all cross-callee contamination.
Realtime page-directory COW still copies O(window length / 128) page references. This change only avoids writing an exactly retained prefix cell during same-bar undo.
Noncertified WMA/HMA and variance scans, Map/Matrix secondary string dispatch and recursive HIR evaluation remain. This round does not establish their relative profiling contribution.
